result.stdout:
usage: duackcli <command> [options]

  convert  <contentDir> <outDir> [--playlists <file>]
           [--quality <0..1>] [--force] [--all]
           (a playlist source is required; --all converts every WAV)
  scan     <audioRoot> [--out <file>]
           (writes an audio-manifest.json of the SFX/ + Tracks/ cues)
  normalize <dir> [<outDir>] [--out <dir>]
           (measures track loudness, finds the loudest, and writes gain-normalized WAVs)
